family: K is the number of candidates with status grade. Unreadable candidates stay in this file and do not enter K.
pass: Both halves have net3 > 0 and each half's recomputed t_net is at least the one-sided normal Bonferroni critical value of a single-test t of 2.0 across K. t_net = published_t * net3 / published_mean, and published_t must be the t of that same mean. A missing t cannot pass.
promising: Both halves have net3 > 0. A pooled mean is scored only from an explicit pooled object {mean_bp, t} copied from the source. That object's net3 must be > 0 and its t_net must clear the Bonferroni critical value of a single-test t of 1.5 across K. These four candidates have no pooled object. Per-half t cannot make a row PROMISING. A half with net3 <= 0 is FAIL.
net3: If the published figure is a gross, net3 = gross - 3. If it is a net at cost C, gross = net + C and net3 = gross - 3. A realized fill-to-fill mean is already after the spread that was paid; do not subtract another 3 bp. Grade that mean against 0.
